methodology.openapiOrder: AB, BA, then one bounded AB confirmation
methodology.sourceMetric: loader probe + AST traversal probe + complete NestJS analyzer + contract comparison
methodology.warmMeaning: subsequent repetitions in one Node process; source probe loader cached, complete analyzer loads its own project
methodology.openapiPair1: Observed major variation across parse/resolve/normalize (1000-op warm 124.560..1305.671ms, 10000-op warm 1131.288..4002.482ms). Preserve all samples and all-observed statistics; do not attribute that difference to the patch. Pairs 2 and 3 are reported separately for the reproducible comparison.
methodology.comparisonLimits: One local macOS arm64 host; synthetic fixtures; no production latency or hosted performance baseline claim.

safety: Candidate write index and symbol facts are scoped to one projectSources identity and published after complete traversal. Pointer cache is scoped to one resolver call and document identity. Cancellation/deadline, dynamic/unknown behavior, reference-context checks, depth/node accounting and realpath boundaries remain in the canonical path.
